'''Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)''' was a GeoCities SWCCG fan site for the Corellia region, hosted at <code>geocities.com/plarathas/</code> and <code>geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/</code>. The surviving homepage calls it an unofficial site (not produced or endorsed by Decipher or Lucasfilm) with decks, strategy, card reviews, a player database, [[Anagrams|Anagramed Decipherians]], and the [[Squadron Members]] roster.

The webmaster mailbox on the preserved pages is the Indiana State University address used as <code>plarathas</code> on Yahoo GeoCities. A sidebar ranks the site in a Top 100 CCG list as id <code>gold31</code>. The last homepage note on the mirrors is 15 August 2005 (GenCon / SWCCG Worlds in Indianapolis; the editor wrote the site had reopened and was looking for contributors).

Nav-bar "Top SWCCG Sites" on the 2005 homepage: Decipher Inc, Corellian Engineering, SWCCG Players Committee, [[DeckTech]], [[GamePlayers Network]], HoloTable, SWCCG Database.


== Deck designs ==

The Deck Designs page listed Classic Star Wars Light and Dark plus Young Jedi Jedi and Sith. Every surviving capture from 9 July 2000 through 23 October 2009 shows the same index titles and an empty Classic Dark heading. Wayback kept HTTP 200 bodies for light1.html, light2.html, and jedi1.html on the CollegePark host (December 2001). light3.html and sith1.html were linked from that index but were not captured as HTTP 200 on original GeoCities; they survive on the geocities.ws mirror.

The Classic Star Wars reading copies are on [[Corellian Engineering Corporation decks]]. Young Jedi lists stay on the archived HTML.

== Mirrors and archives ==

* Original GeoCities home (Wayback, HTTP 200): [https://web.archive.org/web/20010513005725/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ 13 May 2001] · [https://web.archive.org/web/20010517194935/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ 17 May 2001] · [https://web.archive.org/web/20010526161604/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ 26 May 2001] · [https://web.archive.org/web/20010721002349/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ 21 July 2001]
* Original <code>geocities.com/plarathas/SMs.html</code> on Wayback is [https://web.archive.org/web/20091028130457/http://geocities.com/plarathas/SMs.html 28 October 2009, HTTP 410] (after Yahoo closed GeoCities).
* [https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/ geocities.ws/plarathas] (live third-party mirror)
* [https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/ oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433] (live; Wayback from 2019, including [https://web.archive.org/web/20190131115529/http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html anagrams.html 31 January 2019])
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20160406045459/http://www.reocities.com/CollegePark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html reocities anagrams] (Wayback 6 April 2016; also 9 May 2014 and 20 February 2016) — the URL Encyclopedia 3.2 cites

The 13 May 2001 original home is richer than the 2005 mirror: it says Decipher's site mentioned CEC twice ([https://web.archive.org/web/20010513005725/http://www.decipher.com/newsflash/1999/0899/080499storyB.html 4 August 1999] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20010513005725/http://www.decipher.com/newsflash/1999/0999/092799storyA.html 27 September 1999]); links sister site The Outpost (<code>tco.htmlplanet.com</code>); hosts Jeff Hansen ([[Jeff Hansen|Rogue 5]]) "Neglected Cards"; and advertises the 3rd Annual King of Corellia (Carmel, Indiana) with TDs [[Alex Alcalde]] Gold 31, [[John Kaufeld]], and [[Craig Spaid]] Bravo 36, a tournament [[John Sarnecki]] had introduced before retiring. Other linked pages on that capture: Indiana.html, awards.html, pics.html, anagrams.html, ratings.html, stats.html, [http://kingofcorellia.homestead.com/ kingofcorellia.homestead.com], Star Wars CCG XChange (<code>pagesz.net/~billyak/swxchange</code>), Bill Yak's Final Conflict (<code>billyak.com/fc/</code>).

Yahoo closed GeoCities in 2009. The 2001 Wayback captures plus oocities / geocities.ws / reocities are why the roster and anagram table still exist.
